environment.description: EKS pod running the same gRPC server in namespace 'services'. The Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The pod's service account is annotated with an IRSA role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/grpc-proxy-role), but the role's trust policy restricts the audience claim to 'sts.amazonaws.com' and the role has NO lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission in its attached policies. Additionally, the VPC endpoint policy for the Lambda service (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.lambda) includes a Condition restricting aws:PrincipalArn to a different role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/authorized-invoker-role). The pod's outbound requests to the Lambda function URL will receive HTTP 403 regardless of headers injected, because SigV4 signing with the pod's credentials will be rejected at the Lambda IAM authorizer layer due to missing lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission.

config.grpc_exposure: ClusterIP, accessed via Istio ingress gateway with JWT validation
